issues.title: Ingest Lonoke County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $54,583,074 across 48 funds. The largest: Road and Bridge ($20,126,289), Law Enforcement Fund ($9,916,019), ARPA Revenue Replacement Fund ($8,085,901). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Collector's Automation Fund
issues.detail: Only page 2 of this form is in the filed document (p. 106). It prints the other-services total ($139,000.00) and the total appropriation ($357,228.13); page 1 with personal services and supplies is missing, so the categories shown do not add up to the total. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
